$comment: Single source of truth for the Input API (with Field, Label, Hint and Error). Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: input
title: Input
description: A text field with its label, hint and error message.

label (Field).description: Field only: the visible label, linked to the input.

hint (Field).description: Field only: help text under the input.

error (Field).description: Field only: an error message. Also marks the input invalid.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Field connects the label, the input and the hint for you. In HTML, match the for/id and aria-describedby yourself.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three heights that line up with the Button sizes. Inputs without a visible label need an aria-label.

examples.title: Error, disabled, multi-line
examples.description: An error message marks the input invalid and is read out with it. Use multiline for longer text.

a11y: Every input has a label: a visible <label for> or, if there is no visible label, an aria-label.
Hints and errors are linked with aria-describedby, so screen readers read them with the field.
An error sets aria-invalid="true" and is shown as text, not only as a red border.
Visible focus ring in every style and mode.
